people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
translations.bsb: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats, one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat,
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
translations.asv: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.
